# FileDragIcon

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFileDragIcon` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasFileDragIcon.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasFileDragIcon.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasFileDragIcon.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The icon of a file about to be saved, dragged onto a folder of the window to choose where it goes (the RISC OS save box's icon; the Save dialog has a big one left of its name and type, "Drag to Folder" under it)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasFileDialog](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasFileDialog.md)
- [UltraCanvasFilerWidget](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasFilerWidget.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFileDragIcon> CreateFileDragIcon( const std::string& identifier, const std::string& fileName, long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 28, long h = 28);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFileDragIcon(const std::string& identifier, long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 28, long h = 28);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onDragStarted` | `std::function<void()> onDragStarted` | _Drag started_ |
| `onDropped` | `std::function<void(UltraCanvasUIElement* target, const Point2Di& windowPoint)> onDropped` | The icon was released over `target` - the element under the pointer, never the icon itself; null over nothing - at `windowPoint`. Runs while the target still shows where the drop lands, before it is sent DragLeave. |
| `onDroppedOnFolder` | `std::function<void(const std::string& folder)> onDroppedOnFolder` | The drag left the window and was dropped on a folder of another window or program, which named it (a local path). Not called when the drop landed on anything else. |
| `onDragCancelled` | `std::function<void()> onDragCancelled` | Escape, or the pointer was taken away: nothing dropped. |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | Pressed and released without dragging. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFileName` | `void SetFileName(const std::string& name, bool isFolder = false)` | A file name or a path ("photo.png"), or a folder. The icon and the badge that follows the pointer are drawn for it. |
| `SetIconPainter` | `void SetIconPainter(IconPainter painter)` | The icon of the type. Without a painter: DrawDocumentGlyph in a neutral blue (a folder shape for a folder). The file dialog draws that page in the colour its listing gives the type, or the listing's own icon when it shows this desktop's (UltraCanvasFilerWidget:: GetTypeColors, DrawTypeIcon). |
| `SetDragThreshold` | `void SetDragThreshold(int pixels)` | How far (in pixels) the pointer moves with the button down before a press becomes a drag. A press that never gets that far is a click (onClick). |
